headline: Executive order sets policy for how federal agencies manage the buildings and land owned or used by the government.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how the federal government manages its real property, meaning the buildings, land, and facilities it owns or leases. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, duties, and deadlines it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that own or lease buildings and land
who_it_affects.how: They are likely subject to new or updated rules for managing their property.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 4, 2004; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
